'Target hero may pay {r}{r}{r}. If they don't, freeze a card in their arsenal or an ally they control until the start of your next turn. / If Cold Snap is played from arsenal, draw a card.' + printed Go again. Red printing - identical shape to the already-drafted .drafts/cold_snap_blue.json, resources 3 per the red cost.

PRINTED KEYWORDS NOT AUTHORED: GoAgain is in printed_keywords - it fires from the card DB keywords field, and re-authoring a printed keyword is a defect. The DB 'Freeze' tag is inert by itself; the actual freezing is the effect below, per the triage list.

CLAUSE 1: PAY_OR_ELSE (effect_types.py:3207-3257) reads player/resources/on_failure - all three verified in the handler. player OPPONENT asks the TARGET hero (2-player equivalence; no separate hero-target declaration authored). The handler offers pay/decline FIRST and runs on_failure only on decline or inability to afford, so release note 2's ordering ('the target hero chooses if they are paying first; you do not choose what you are freezing until they choose not to pay') falls out of the machinery, as does note 1: the payer is asked regardless of board state, and declining with nothing freezable freezes nothing.

FREEZE POOL: object-target spec (effect_types.py:675-804) with zones ARSENAL + ARENA. There is no ALLIES entry in the object-target zone vocabulary (_OBJECT_TARGET_ZONES, effect_types.py:418) - ARENA maps to player.permanents (effect_types.py:463-464), which holds allies AND items/auras/tokens as SubZoneViews (state.py:867-871) - so the OR filter narrows the pool to exactly the printed targets: a card still in their arsenal (SELF_IN_ZONE reads the candidate's own zone attribute, condition_types.py:1544-1560) OR an Ally (CARD_IS_TYPE tests types UNION subtypes, condition_types.py:1309-1325). amount 1 makes the CONTROLLER choose one via the standard prompt (_ask_player at effect_types.py:795).

GAP - DURATION: 'until the start of your next turn' is NOT expressible. The DSL FREEZE effect (effect_types.py:3149-3178) reads only ref/target and calls effect_keywords.freeze() without any until/duration parameter, which defaults to CR 8.5.34b: unfreeze at the start of the FROZEN CARD'S CONTROLLER'S next turn. For a card frozen in the OPPONENT's arsenal/ally row that thaws one player-turn EARLIER than printed (their next turn start, instead of surviving their whole turn and thawing when MINE starts). Needs a duration param on DSL FREEZE (forwarded to freeze()'s until_condition) to fix generically; drafted with the default rather than inventing a flag-based thaw.

CLAUSE 2: second PLAY ability gated by PLAYED_FROM_ARSENAL (condition_types.py:789-809 - prefers play.py's explicit played_from_zone stamp, falls back to prev_zone) drawing 1; DRAW reads amount/player (effect_types.py:1222-1249).
